title: Connection account v1
description: The outside account behind a connection, as the blob `connectors.capability_granted` points at (content type `application/vnd.campbooks.connection-account+json; version=1`). Personal data, so it travels as a blob of the workspace, never inline in an event.

provider.description: The provider; more values arrive with their adapters. `imap`: any mailbox over IMAP and SMTP, connected with its password.

address_verified.description: Whether the provider verified the address. An unverified address must not be treated as the account's identity.

display_name.description: The account's display name, when the provider gives one.
